name: Demand zone long
idea: Price comes back to a demand zone that an explosive move up left behind (a base, a swing's extreme candle, or a broken zone with swap levels on). The signal is the touch, a confirmation candle or the retest, as you choose. The idea is wrong on a close beyond the far line by your buffer.

params.label: Average range (candles)
params.help: The candles of the average range each candle is measured against. Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Leg candle size
params.help: A leg candle's range is at least this many times the average range. Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Base candle size
params.help: A base candle's range is at most this many times the average range. Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Leg-out size
params.help: The leg-out candle's range is at least this many times the average range (or ATR). Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Leg candle body (%)
params.help: A leg candle's body is at least this percent of its range. Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Base candle body (%)
params.help: A base candle's body is at most this percent of its range. Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Base candles at most
params.help: At most this many base candles in a row. Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Leg-out measured against
params.help: What the leg-out candle's range is compared with.

params.label: Zone near line
params.help: The near line of a zone: the base's wick, or its candle bodies. Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Skip flat candles
params.help: On: a flat candle (high equals low) is never counted as a base candle. Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Zones read
params.help: Which zones: a base between two moves, the swing's extreme candle, or both. Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Swing: candles before
params.help: A swing extreme is beyond the highs (supply) or lows (demand) of this many candles before it. Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Swing: confirmed within (candles)
params.help: A swing zone counts only once a later candle closes without touching it, within this many candles. Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Two-candle engulfing zone
params.help: On: when the extreme candle engulfs the candle before it, the zone is the two candles. Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Swap levels
params.help: On: a zone broken by a strong candle stays as a zone of the other side. Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Swap: breaking candle size
params.help: The breaking candle's range is at least this many times the average range (0: any break). Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: How the zone is reached
params.help: First touch of a fresh zone; a confirmation candle closing back outside its near line; or the first return to a broken zone (break and retest, needs swap levels on). Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Confirmation within (candles)
params.help: The confirmation candle counts within this many candles from the first touch. Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Confirmation candle body (%)
params.help: The confirmation candle's body is at least this percent of its range. Reference value - edit before use.

params.label: Extra check (optional)
params.help: Optional: what must also hold on that candle. None by default.

params.label: ATR period
params.help: The bars of the average true range the buffer is measured in.

params.label: Buffer beyond the far line (ATR)
params.help: How many average true ranges beyond the zone's far line the idea is wrong (0 means not set: the far line itself).

params.label: Minimum reward:risk (off)
params.help: Optional and off by default (0). When you set it, a signal whose reward to the opposing zone's near line is less than this many times its risk is skipped; with no opposing zone nothing is measured. Reference 2 (2:1) - reference, edit before use.

constraints.message: The base candle size must be below the leg candle size
The base candle size must be below the leg-out size

setup.long: SDZoneEntry("demand", $entry, avg_n=$avg_n, leg_mult=$leg_mult, base_mult=$base_mult, out_mult=$out_mult, leg_body_pct=$leg_body_pct, base_body_pct=$base_body_pct, base_max=$base_max, out_ref=$out_ref, edge=$edge, skip_flat_bars=$skip_flat_bars, kind=$kind, swing_left=$swing_left, confirm_within=$confirm_within, engulf=$engulf, swap=$swap, swap_mult=$swap_mult, confirm_bars=$confirm_bars, confirm_body_pct=$confirm_body_pct)
setup.short: SDZoneEntry("supply", $entry, avg_n=$avg_n, leg_mult=$leg_mult, base_mult=$base_mult, out_mult=$out_mult, leg_body_pct=$leg_body_pct, base_body_pct=$base_body_pct, base_max=$base_max, out_ref=$out_ref, edge=$edge, skip_flat_bars=$skip_flat_bars, kind=$kind, swing_left=$swing_left, confirm_within=$confirm_within, engulf=$engulf, swap=$swap, swap_mult=$swap_mult, confirm_bars=$confirm_bars, confirm_body_pct=$confirm_body_pct)

trigger.long: SDZoneEntry("demand", $entry, avg_n=$avg_n, leg_mult=$leg_mult, base_mult=$base_mult, out_mult=$out_mult, leg_body_pct=$leg_body_pct, base_body_pct=$base_body_pct, base_max=$base_max, out_ref=$out_ref, edge=$edge, skip_flat_bars=$skip_flat_bars, kind=$kind, swing_left=$swing_left, confirm_within=$confirm_within, engulf=$engulf, swap=$swap, swap_mult=$swap_mult, confirm_bars=$confirm_bars, confirm_body_pct=$confirm_body_pct) AND ($min_rr <= 0 OR NOT (SDZoneEdge("supply", "proximal", avg_n=$avg_n, leg_mult=$leg_mult, base_mult=$base_mult, out_mult=$out_mult, leg_body_pct=$leg_body_pct, base_body_pct=$base_body_pct, base_max=$base_max, out_ref=$out_ref, edge=$edge, skip_flat_bars=$skip_flat_bars, kind=$kind, swing_left=$swing_left, confirm_within=$confirm_within, engulf=$engulf, swap=$swap, swap_mult=$swap_mult) - close < $min_rr * (close - (SDZoneEntryRef("demand", "distal", $entry, avg_n=$avg_n, leg_mult=$leg_mult, base_mult=$base_mult, out_mult=$out_mult, leg_body_pct=$leg_body_pct, base_body_pct=$base_body_pct, base_max=$base_max, out_ref=$out_ref, edge=$edge, skip_flat_bars=$skip_flat_bars, kind=$kind, swing_left=$swing_left, confirm_within=$confirm_within, engulf=$engulf, swap=$swap, swap_mult=$swap_mult, confirm_bars=$confirm_bars, confirm_body_pct=$confirm_body_pct) - $buf * ATR($atr_n)[1]))))
trigger.short: SDZoneEntry("supply", $entry, avg_n=$avg_n, leg_mult=$leg_mult, base_mult=$base_mult, out_mult=$out_mult, leg_body_pct=$leg_body_pct, base_body_pct=$base_body_pct, base_max=$base_max, out_ref=$out_ref, edge=$edge, skip_flat_bars=$skip_flat_bars, kind=$kind, swing_left=$swing_left, confirm_within=$confirm_within, engulf=$engulf, swap=$swap, swap_mult=$swap_mult, confirm_bars=$confirm_bars, confirm_body_pct=$confirm_body_pct) AND ($min_rr <= 0 OR NOT (close - SDZoneEdge("demand", "proximal", avg_n=$avg_n, leg_mult=$leg_mult, base_mult=$base_mult, out_mult=$out_mult, leg_body_pct=$leg_body_pct, base_body_pct=$base_body_pct, base_max=$base_max, out_ref=$out_ref, edge=$edge, skip_flat_bars=$skip_flat_bars, kind=$kind, swing_left=$swing_left, confirm_within=$confirm_within, engulf=$engulf, swap=$swap, swap_mult=$swap_mult) < $min_rr * ((SDZoneEntryRef("supply", "distal", $entry, avg_n=$avg_n, leg_mult=$leg_mult, base_mult=$base_mult, out_mult=$out_mult, leg_body_pct=$leg_body_pct, base_body_pct=$base_body_pct, base_max=$base_max, out_ref=$out_ref, edge=$edge, skip_flat_bars=$skip_flat_bars, kind=$kind, swing_left=$swing_left, confirm_within=$confirm_within, engulf=$engulf, swap=$swap, swap_mult=$swap_mult, confirm_bars=$confirm_bars, confirm_body_pct=$confirm_body_pct) + $buf * ATR($atr_n)[1]) - close)))

close_back.long: close > SDZoneEntryRef("demand", "proximal", $entry, avg_n=$avg_n, leg_mult=$leg_mult, base_mult=$base_mult, out_mult=$out_mult, leg_body_pct=$leg_body_pct, base_body_pct=$base_body_pct, base_max=$base_max, out_ref=$out_ref, edge=$edge, skip_flat_bars=$skip_flat_bars, kind=$kind, swing_left=$swing_left, confirm_within=$confirm_within, engulf=$engulf, swap=$swap, swap_mult=$swap_mult, confirm_bars=$confirm_bars, confirm_body_pct=$confirm_body_pct)
close_back.short: close < SDZoneEntryRef("supply", "proximal", $entry, avg_n=$avg_n, leg_mult=$leg_mult, base_mult=$base_mult, out_mult=$out_mult, leg_body_pct=$leg_body_pct, base_body_pct=$base_body_pct, base_max=$base_max, out_ref=$out_ref, edge=$edge, skip_flat_bars=$skip_flat_bars, kind=$kind, swing_left=$swing_left, confirm_within=$confirm_within, engulf=$engulf, swap=$swap, swap_mult=$swap_mult, confirm_bars=$confirm_bars, confirm_body_pct=$confirm_body_pct)
